nodes.name: Upload Preview Image to Cloudflare Images
nodes.notes: Uploads preview images to Cloudflare Images after R2 upload. Place this node AFTER 'Upload Page Preview Image to R2'. Enable 'Continue On Fail' so workflow continues if Cloudflare upload fails.

nodes.name: Store Cloudflare Images ID
nodes.notes: Extracts Cloudflare Images ID from upload response and combines with page data. Outputs pageNumber, r2Key, cloudflareImageId, and cloudflareImageUrl for manifest building.
